author: Karl Rock
description:
Karachi has some markets you won't find anywhere else, but two of them are particularly dark.

First, there's the huge thieves' market in New Karachi Town, where stolen goods, questionable electronics and all sorts of unusual items find their way onto the stalls.

Then there's the Saddar Sunday Pet Market, where the trade in animals raises some serious questions about animal welfare and the conditions they're kept in.

Both markets reveal a very different side of Karachi, and neither is for the faint-hearted.

Have you ever visited either of these markets?
title: Karachi's Darkest Markets
